create_description: fix the off-by-one in clampPage so a requested page index stays within the valid page range
prompt: Our slideshow pager lets people click past the last page and before the first page. `clampPage(index, pageCount)` in src/page.mjs should constrain the requested index to the valid range [0, pageCount - 1], but paging forward past the last page lands one index past the end. Fix it so any index is clamped into range. The regression command is `npm test`; it should fail before the fix and pass after the fix. Keep the change focused.
trap_note: Symptom patch: Math.min(index, pageCount - 1) clears the visible upper-bound case but still returns a negative index when paging before the first page. Root cause: Math.max(0, Math.min(index, pageCount - 1)) clamps both ends, which the hidden lower-bound check requires.
